header.description: Crystal PvP practice bot as SimulatedPlayer. Requires Beta APIs experiment ON. v0.5.1: Phase-1 fixes — replaced nonexistent SimulatedPlayer.attack/interact with real attackEntity/interactWithBlock, loadout sync keeps weapons (mace/bow/crossbow/axe/shield/elytra), self-damage capped by HP, armor model corrected to 4%/pt & EPF 4%/pt, dive exclusive during flight.
